description: Permanently delete entities from the drawing, atomically and in memory. Works on LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, POINT, 3DFACE, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, LWPOLYLINE, ELLIPSE, SOLID, SPLINE and HATCH; an entity that other objects reference (such as an associative dimension's target) or a block reference with attributes is refused. There is no undo: re-open the source file to recover.
name: cad.delete_entities
